scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w packages/generator && npm run build -w packages/scorer && npm run build -w packages/voice && npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/types -w packages/db && npm test --workspaces
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w packages/types -w packages/db && npm run test:coverage --workspaces
scripts.integration: npm run build -w packages/types -w packages/db -w packages/engine && npm run integration --workspace=packages/engine
